    • getInput

      public I getInput()
      Description copied from interface: NestedChannelRequest
      Get the input channel, if any. This corresponds to the output channel on the remote side.

      It's possible that the returned channel requires a non-default SelectorProvider; if so, that must be documented by the implementation. Unless specified otherwise, the default SelectorProvider may be assumed. In any case, the channels returned by NestedChannelRequest.getInput() and NestedChannelRequest.getOutput() must share the same SelectorProvider.

      Closing this channel also closes the channel returned by NestedChannelRequest.getOutput().

      In some implementations, NestedChannelRequest.getInput() and NestedChannelRequest.getOutput() may return the same channel; this is explicitly permitted.

      Specified by:
      getInput in interface NestedChannelRequest<I extends SelectableChannel & ReadableByteChannel,O extends SelectableChannel & WritableByteChannel>
      Returns:
      the input channel associated with this instance, or null if this instance was created with only an output channel

    • getOutput

      public O getOutput()
      Description copied from interface: NestedChannelRequest
      Get the output channel, if any. This corresponds to the input channel on the remote side.

      It's possible that the returned channel requires a non-default SelectorProvider; if so, that must be documented by the implementation. Unless specified otherwise, the default SelectorProvider may be assumed. In any case, the channels returned by NestedChannelRequest.getInput() and NestedChannelRequest.getOutput() must share the same SelectorProvider.

      Closing this channel also closes the channel returned by NestedChannelRequest.getInput().

      In some implementations, NestedChannelRequest.getInput() and NestedChannelRequest.getOutput() may return the same channel; this is explicitly permitted.

      Specified by:
      getOutput in interface NestedChannelRequest<I extends SelectableChannel & ReadableByteChannel,O extends SelectableChannel & WritableByteChannel>
      Returns:
      the output channel associated with this instance, or null if this instance was created with only an input channel
